places.name: Niagara Falls
places.ai_summary: Niagara Falls is a world-famous natural wonder featuring breathtaking waterfalls and thrilling attractions.

opening_hours.notes: Illumination and fireworks schedules vary.

places.place_tip: Take a boat tour to experience the falls up close.

places.name: CN Tower
places.ai_summary: The CN Tower is an iconic landmark in Toronto offering panoramic views, a glass floor, and a revolving restaurant.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary during holidays.

places.place_tip: Try the EdgeWalk for an adrenaline rush.

places.name: Parliament Hill (Ottawa)
places.ai_summary: Parliament Hill is the political and cultural heart of Canada, featuring historic buildings and the iconic Peace Tower.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours require prior booking.

places.place_tip: Attend the Changing of the Guard ceremony in summer.

attribution.title: Ottawa - ON - Stadtansicht
attribution.author: Wladyslaw
attribution.description: Ottawa: Stadtansicht auf den Parliament Hill vom Majors Hill Park aus, links vom Parlament erkennt man die Staustufen des Rideau Canal, rechts am Rand steht das mit 112 m höchste Gebäude der Stadt Place de Ville II

places.name: Royal Ontario Museum (ROM)
places.ai_summary: The Royal Ontario Museum is one of the largest museums in North America, featuring art, culture, and nature exhibits.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission is 1 hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Visit the dinosaur gallery and the ancient civilizations exhibit.

places.name: Art Gallery of Ontario (AGO)
places.ai_summary: The Art Gallery of Ontario is one of the most distinguished art museums in North America, with a collection spanning centuries and the globe.

opening_hours.notes: Free admission on Wednesdays from 6:00 pm to 9:00 pm.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the Group of Seven paintings and the contemporary art collection.
places.address: 317 Dundas St W, Toronto, Ontario, Canada

places.name: Toronto Islands
places.ai_summary: The Toronto Islands are a group of small islands in Lake Ontario, offering a peaceful retreat from the city with beaches, parks, and recreational activities.

opening_hours.notes: Ferry operates from 6:00 am to 11:00 pm.

places.place_tip: Take the ferry from downtown Toronto and explore the islands by bike.

attribution.title: Toronto Islands 2025-05-08
attribution.author: JK Liu
attribution.description: Aerial view of Toronto Island from airplane

places.name: Algonquin Provincial Park
places.ai_summary: Algonquin Provincial Park is a vast wilderness area offering stunning landscapes, wildlife viewing, and outdoor activities like hiking and canoeing.

opening_hours.notes: Visitor Centre open from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm.

places.place_tip: Explore the park's many trails and look for moose along the way.

attribution.title: Algonquin Cache Lake Lookout
attribution.author: Original uploader was Ptrbnsn at en.wikipedia

places.name: Thousand Islands
places.ai_summary: The Thousand Islands is a picturesque region along the St. Lawrence River, known for its stunning archipelago, boating, and historical sites.

opening_hours.notes: Boat tour times vary by season.

places.place_tip: Take a boat tour to explore the islands and visit Boldt Castle.

places.name: Canada's Wonderland
places.ai_summary: Canada's Wonderland is a premier amusement park featuring a wide variety of rides, shows, and attractions for all ages.

opening_hours.notes: Hours vary for special events and holidays.

places.place_tip: Arrive early to enjoy popular rides with shorter wait times.
places.address: 1 Canada's Wonderland Dr, Vaughan, Ontario, Canada

places.name: St. Lawrence Market
places.ai_summary: St. Lawrence Market is a historic market in Toronto, offering a variety of fresh produce, gourmet foods, and unique souvenirs.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary for individual vendors.

places.place_tip: Try the peameal bacon sandwich at Carousel Bakery.
places.address: 93 Front St E, Toronto, Ontario, Canada

places.name: National Gallery of Canada
places.ai_summary: The National Gallery of Canada is a prominent art museum in Ottawa, housing a vast collection of Canadian and international art.

opening_hours.notes: Free admission on Thursdays from 5:00 pm to 8:00 pm.

places.place_tip: Explore the Canadian Art section and the stunning architecture of the building.

attribution.title: Ottawa - ON - National Gallery of Canada
attribution.author: – Wladyslaw [Disk.]

places.name: Casa Loma
places.ai_summary: Casa Loma is a Gothic Revival style mansion and garden in Toronto, now functioning as a museum and landmark.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission is at 4:00 pm.

places.place_tip: Explore the beautiful gardens and don't miss the tower view.

attribution.title: Exterior of Casa Loma, June 2012
attribution.author: Priscilla Jordão from São Paulo, Brasil
attribution.description: Casa Loma, 1 Austin Terrace, Toronto, Ontario, Canada

places.name: ByWard Market
places.ai_summary: ByWard Market is a vibrant neighborhood in Ottawa, known for its historic market, shops, restaurants, and nightlife.

opening_hours.notes: Individual vendor hours may vary.

places.place_tip: Visit the local shops and try the BeaverTails pastry.

places.name: Ripley's Aquarium of Canada
places.ai_summary: Ripley's Aquarium of Canada is a large public aquarium in Toronto, featuring a wide variety of marine life and interactive exhibits.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission is 1 hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the underwater tunnel and the interactive touch pools.

attribution.title: Ripley's Aquarium of Canada, Toronto, Ontario
attribution.author: EuroCarGT
attribution.description: The Ripley's Aquarium of Canada in Toronto, Canada. Located on Bremner Blvd, it is a tourist attraction along with surrounding buildings in the area.

places.name: Distillery District
places.ai_summary: The Distillery District is a historic and entertainment precinct in Toronto, known for its well-preserved Victorian industrial architecture and vibrant arts scene.

opening_hours.notes: Many shops and galleries have variable hours.

places.place_tip: Explore the art galleries, boutiques, and enjoy a meal at a local restaurant.

places.name: Bruce Peninsula National Park
places.ai_summary: Bruce Peninsula National Park is a natural paradise with stunning cliffs, clear waters, and diverse wildlife, offering excellent hiking and camping opportunities.

opening_hours.notes: Visitor Centre open from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm.

places.place_tip: Hike the Bruce Trail and visit the Grotto for a swim.
places.address: Bruce Peninsula National Park, Ontario, Canada

places.name: Canadian War Museum
places.ai_summary: The Canadian War Museum in Ottawa is dedicated to presenting Canada’s military history, with extensive exhibits and a vast collection of artifacts.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission is at 4:00 pm.

places.place_tip: Explore the Canadian Experience Hall and the Memorial Hall.

attribution.title: WarMuseum2022
attribution.author: Harleyd613
attribution.description: Overview of the Canadian War Museum in 2022

places.name: Hockey Hall of Fame
places.ai_summary: The Hockey Hall of Fame in Toronto is a museum dedicated to the history of ice hockey, featuring exhibits, memorabilia, and interactive displays.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary during holidays.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the Stanley Cup and the interactive hockey shootout.

attribution.title: Hockey Hall of Fame 2025-05-24
attribution.author: JK Liu

places.name: Rideau Canal National Historic Site
places.ai_summary: The Rideau Canal is a UNESCO World Heritage Site in Ottawa, offering scenic views, boating, and ice skating in winter.

opening_hours.notes: Lock stations have variable hours.

places.best_time_to_visit: Fall for foliage, winter for skating
places.place_tip: Walk or bike along the canal path, and visit the ByWard Market nearby.

places.name: Niagara-on-the-Lake
places.ai_summary: Niagara-on-the-Lake is a charming town known for its well-preserved 19th-century architecture, boutique shops, and proximity to Niagara Falls.

opening_hours.notes: Shops and restaurants have variable hours.

places.place_tip: Explore the historic district and enjoy a wine tasting tour.
